candidate_windows.window_text: Our experiments involve zero-shot evaluations of pre-trained NLI models on downstream NLP tasks. In this section, we describe the transfer learning setup and the datasets used in our experiments.

- The hyperparams for the models used throughout the Section 6 are shown in Table 18. These were obtained using minimal manual tuning.   
- The threshold for CFCS as classification experiments (Section 6.2 (1)) we calculated by tuning for best balanced accuracy https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics-balanced.accuracy_score.html.
